lines.trans: One moment, I ask for everyone's attention.
All of you know Ekaterina well.
Today she is on our team again.
Guys, look who has returned to us!
Hello everyone, I am very glad too.
Louis, get away from me, you naughty man!
Katya, you are simply a beauty today.
And who is this new guy?
And this one here is our newcomer.
But he still cooks very poorly.
He is on familiar terms with music.
But with food he is still a stranger.
